## What changed and why

Describe the user-visible problem and the resulting behavior. Link an issue when relevant.

## Validation

List the commands run and their results. Include screenshots for UI changes.

- [ ] Added or updated regression coverage where behavior changed
- [ ] CI passes, or remaining failures are explained
- [ ] Considered accessibility and localization for UI changes
- [ ] Preserved compatibility with existing clients and stored data
- [ ] Updated relevant documentation and version fields
- [ ] No credentials, personal data, or generated build artifacts included

## Release notes

List migrations, configuration changes, manual checks, and rollback considerations, or write “None”. Deployment is a separate, human-operated step.
